title: AquaTerra in December 2024: {count} drives and The Starry Night
description: December 2024 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, from Christmas craft workshops and carol singing to The Starry Night carnival and dog feeding in Salt Lake.
lede: In December 2024 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, and the month was built around Christmas. Children made ornaments, masks, wrapping paper and crafts at Pather Sathi, Ek Tara and other places we keep going back to. On 22 December the team ran The Starry Night, a Christmas carnival at Sky Turf that raises funds for our welfare work, and the month had {volunteers} volunteer turnouts in all.

sections.heading: christmas in workshops
body: Most of the month was Christmas workshops for children. At Pather Sathi, kids decorated a Christmas tree and practised public speaking on 28 December, answered a Christmas quiz and wrote letters on 14 December, and joined a carnival workshop on 21 December with games, music, crafts and treats. {topPlace} was the most frequent place in December, with more sessions there than anywhere else.

Ek Tara had children decorate a tree and craft ornaments on 13 and 20 December. At AIM Foundation on 20 December, Festive Fun had children make Christmas crafts by cutting, colouring and designing. Secret Cheer at Tetultala Ashram on 17 December had children make wrapping paper, which volunteers then used to wrap gifts for a secret Santa game with the children later.

sections.heading: the starry night and shoot for the stars
body: The Starry Night, on 22 December at Sky Turf, was the month's big evening. It brought music, food and cheer, and it was held to raise funds and awareness for our ongoing welfare work. A full team of volunteers ran it from start to finish.

Shoot for the Stars came earlier in the month, a basketball fundraiser on 14 December at Chetla Park Athletic Club with matches, stalls and merchandise. Both nights are part of how AquaTerra pays for the drives that run through the rest of the year. Read more on the [Starry Night](/impact/the-starry-night) page or the [fundraising](/impact/fundraising) page.

sections.heading: dog drives in salt lake and hazra
body: [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) ran feeding drives in December. Drive 22.0 was in Salt Lake on 7 December, and its drive notes 80 dogs fed. Drive 23.0 was also in Salt Lake on 14 December, and Drive 24.0 was in Hazra the same day.
Salt Lake hosted two of the month's feeding drives, and the team went back there within a week. The team in December kept the feeding work going alongside the Christmas workshops.

sections.heading: how to join in
body: A December like this needs a lot of hands at once, but most workshops ran with a handful of volunteers. The easiest way in is a single session. [Join AquaTerra](/join), sign up for a team, and ask to help with a workshop at a place near you. If you want to plan your own session first, read [how to run an art workshop for children](/impact/how-to-run-an-art-workshop-for-kids).

learnings: One theme, Christmas here, can run through a month of very different formats, from carols to crafts to a carnival.
Pair a fundraiser with the workshops around it: both fundraising nights fell in the same two weeks as the children's sessions.
Let children make the materials and then use them, as the Secret Cheer session did when wrapping paper turned into gifts for a game.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in December 2024?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places in December 2024, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Most were Christmas workshops for children, alongside two fundraising nights, The Starry Night at Sky Turf and Shoot for the Stars at Chetla Park Athletic Club, and dog feeding drives in Salt Lake and Hazra.
The Starry Night is AquaTerra's Christmas carnival fundraiser. It was held at Sky Turf on 22 December 2024, with music, food and cheer, and it raises funds for AquaTerra's welfare work.

faqs.q: Where were the Christmas workshops in December 2024?
faqs.a: Pather Sathi hosted the most drives that month. Other Christmas sessions ran at Ek Tara, AIM Foundation, Newtown, Tetultala Ashram, Amader Pradakhep, Calcutta Rescue and Alor Disha.

faqs.q: Can I volunteer for AquaTerra's Christmas workshops?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are between 14 and 19. Join AquaTerra with Google sign-in, wait for approval, and sign up for a team. You can then help with the next session at a place near you.
